name: StudioGo
summary:
# StudioGo

StudioGo is the companion app for ReactVision Studio, the web-based editor for building AR experiences. Design a scene in your browser, open StudioGo on your Quest, and see your work running natively in AR. No build pipeline, no Unity project, no waiting.

Any scene you create or edit in Studio appears in your headset instantly, ready to preview, walk through, and iterate on. Change a model, a light, or an interaction on your laptop and the update is in your headset moments later.

Built for tig
